title: Lost Survival Knowledge
description:
Lost Survival Knowledge documents the self-reliance skills of early American homesteads, trail camps, and backcountry farms — fire, food, water, shelter, weather, and medicine as our great-grandparents actually practiced them.

What a settler family knew wasn't trivia. It was the difference between a hard winter and a fatal one. Every episode is built from period manuals, homestead ledgers, county histories, and firsthand accounts from the 1700s and 1800s, and goes past the surface-level "life hack" version of history to explain why a method worked and why it disappeared.

Narrated by Joe. No synthetic or AI-generated voices.

New episodes weekly. 🪓🔥

title: Evan Mercer
description:
Evan Mercer | Money, Choices & The Lives They Shape

Money rarely changes your life all at once. It changes one ordinary decision at a time.

Through cinematic POV stories, this channel explores how money quietly shapes relationships, work, security, dignity, time, and the options people still have tomorrow.

You’ll step into the lives of ordinary people facing familiar financial choices: the payment that looked affordable, the raise that changed nothing, the house that left no room, the debt that refused to disappear, and the sacrifice no spreadsheet could measure.

These are not stock picks, financial flexes, or get-rich-quick promises. They are human stories about money psychology, hidden financial traps, and the decisions that slowly shape a life.

Because money is never only about money. It is about what you can protect, what you have to postpone, and the life your choices make possible.

For educational and entertainment purposes only. Not financial advice.

description:
Forgotten Ways to Make Money is a dedicated media property exploring the unusual, lost, and overlooked methods of income from throughout history. From defunct colonial trades to the strange side-hustles of the industrial era, we uncover the fascinating ways people made a living.

Our Production Process
We are a fully original production house. We handle every step of the creative cycle:
Research & Scripting: Our team performs deep-dive research into economic archives and historical records to craft 100% original scripts.
Voiceover & Audio: All narration is recorded in-house by the channel owner for a consistent, authentic voice.
Visual Editing: We use Adobe Premiere and After Effects to transform raw assets into a high-quality educational experience.
Licensed Assets: All third-party footage and music are fully licensed.

title: The Evidence-Based Investor
description:
A warm welcome to The Evidence-Based Investor. This is the YouTube channel of Robin Powell, a.k.a. the Evidence-Based Investor, a finance journalist on a journey to uncover the truth behind investing. Robin is a regular columnist for The Times and MoneyWeek.

In each episode, Robin will hear from the experts and share what the evidence says, enabling subscribers to understand the benefits of an evidence-based investing approach and helping to change this hugely important industry for the better. You can read his written posts on his blog (click the link in the banner), or subscribe to this channel for regular video content.
